description: This file implements the RilSapSocket class, which manages socket communication for RIL (Radio Interface Layer) in Android, including socket initialization, request dispatching, and response handling.

classes.name: RilSapSocket
classes.description: Manages socket connections and communication with the RIL for SIM and UIM operations, including request dispatching and response processing.

methods.name: sOnRequestComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of RIL requests, processes responses, and cleans up request objects.

methods.name: sOnUnsolicitedResponse
methods.description: Handles unsolicited responses from the RIL, passing them to the appropriate processing functions.

methods.name: printList
methods.description: Prints the current list of active sockets for debugging purposes.

methods.name: getSocketById
methods.description: Retrieves a socket object based on its socket ID.

methods.name: initSapSocket
methods.description: Initializes a socket based on its name and associated functions.

methods.name: addSocketToList
methods.description: Adds a new socket to the internal linked list of sockets.

methods.name: SocketExists
methods.description: Checks if a socket with the given name already exists.

methods.name: dispatchRequest
methods.description: Dispatches a request to the UIM functions for processing.

methods.name: onRequestComplete
methods.description: Processes the completion of a request, constructs a response, and invokes response processing.

methods.name: onUnsolicitedResponse
methods.description: Handles unsolicited responses from the RIL.
